message.easyelevator.no_cabin: No cabin on this line. Place a cabin on the rail first.
message.easyelevator.multiple_cabins: Multiple cabins on this line. Remove the extra cabin.

screen.easyelevator.title: Select a station
screen.easyelevator.empty: No complete landing doors on this line

screen.easyelevator.door_sound_path: Full path to the audio file
message.easyelevator.door_sound_uploaded: Uploaded the %s; syncing to the whole server.
